derivation: Own derivations (written before opening the claims, scripts tools/verify/25B-A/refute_derive.py): Q1 X,Y iid U(0,1): P(L<1)=pi/4, P(S<1/4)=(1+ln2)/2, cond=pi/(2(1+ln2)) (quarter disc lies inside xy<1/2), E[S]=1/8, var[S]=7/576. Q2 P(B)=(q+s-1)/q, P(AB)=p(q+s-1)/q, P(A)=s-(1-p)P(B); q<1-s impossible; independent iff p+q=1 (s free). Q3 1-prod(1-p^Ni), cond p^N2/P. Q4 c=g=0 (finite variance), a=6(1-2mu)/5, b=(2+6mu)/5, mu in [-1/3,1/2], cond prob =1. Q5 P(Q0)=2p^2-p^3, both=(4p^2-p^3)/3, cond (4-p)/(3(2-p)), 2p^2/(3(1+p-p^2)). Q6 Bin(N,1/365), Poisson(lam/365), n-k~Poisson(lam*364/365). Each cross-checked by 4e6-sample Monte Carlo.
